H1_WILCOXON.description: Wilcoxon signed-rank test comparing paired mAP scores between YOLO11n (M1) and YOLOv8n (M2)
H1_WILCOXON.interpretation: Statistically significant difference detected (p=8.4949e-04 < 0.05) with effect size r=0.696.

H2_MCNEMAR.description: McNemar's test evaluating discordance between Naive Bounding Box and Ground-Contact Proxy
H2_MCNEMAR.interpretation: Ground-contact proxy significantly reduces spatial misclassifications (chi2=11.08, p=8.7409e-04, odds ratio=13.00).

H3_BLAND_ALTMAN.description: Bland-Altman agreement and residual error analysis between Tier B vision and Tier C laser survey
H3_BLAND_ALTMAN.interpretation: Acceptable agreement demonstrated: Mean bias=0.015m, 95% LoA=[-0.049m, 0.079m], MAE=0.028m <= 0.15m, Pearson r=0.997 (p=2.4273e-54).

POWER_ANALYSIS.adequacy_verdict: Target field dataset size N=600 heavily exceeds minimum requirement N=34 for medium effect size (d=0.5), achieving 100.0% statistical power.
